newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks plummet to sharply weaker finish.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks plummet to sharply weaker finish.

text.p: Dhaka stocks took a sharp tumble to finish lower amid investor selling, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index fell 67.03 points or 4.24 percent at 1,474.24 on a turnover of 71.9 million taka. Of 120 traded issues, 97 lost, 18 gained and five unchanged.
"The market is extremely bearish. Investors are trying to escape from a falling market. There is no institutional support for the last several sessions in the market," a broker said.
Leasing company IDLC lost 114 taka to 4,065, Apex Foods shed 201 to 2,691, while Eastern Housing gained 3.69 to 209.92.
